finding_of_record: The wave-1 REAL tables are part-granular levels grids; the ADR-040 additive scheme model binds one LEVELS scheme per question version. Two consequences, both fail-closed: (1) 111 numbers union two grids into one scheme (UNIQUE collision, whole-draft refusal); (2) every grid tiles a PART's marks, never the version's part-sum (R4 refusal at the VALIDATED flip). The DDL, the coverage law, the descriptor law, the ordinal law, the QWK floors and the dispatch inputs all HOLD against the real rows — the mismatch is exactly one axis: scheme binding granularity.
